title: Create or Update Inbound Plan
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-11
html:
Path: /fbt/202602/create_update_inbound_plan

Method: [POST]

Function Description

Creates a new inbound plan or fully replaces the contents of an existing inbound plan by using a goods item list or carton configurations with dimensions. Omit plan_id to create a plan; provide it to update one. Provide exactly one non-empty array: goods_items or cartons; do not provide both. For an update, submit the complete desired goods or carton contents; previously stored goods or cartons omitted from the request are not retained. Using goods_items clears existing carton and lot/expiration data. Using cartons rebuilds the carton and item data.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description

goods_items []object N Goods item list.
^goods_id string Y 231313 The Fulfilled by TikTok goods identifier for this inbound plan item. The goods must belong to the merchant associated with the authenticated seller, be approved for fulfillment, and be matched to an SKU.
^quantity int Y 400 Quantity of this goods item in the inbound plan. Must be greater than 0.
cartons []object N Carton List.
^carton_type string Y SINGLE_SKU Indicates whether the carton is configured as single-SKU or multi-SKU.
